<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/146.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Página-1" id="__J-_rplvjx1_VkV20wa"> <mxGraphModel dx="1717" dy="981" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
' Sequ�ncia: Usu�rio interage com UI, dispara import/export e acompanha status
actor \"Usu�rio (autenticado)\" as User

participant \"UI - /operations (view)\" as UI
participant \"OperationListController\n(app/Http/Controllers/OperationListController.php)\" as ListCtrl
participant \"OperationCsvImportController\n(app/Http/Controllers/OperationCsvImportController.php)\" as ImportCtrl
participant \"OperationReportCsvExportController\n(app/Http/Controllers/OperationReportCsvExportController.php)\" as ExportCtrl
participant \"OperationRunsStatusController\n(app/Http/Controllers/OperationRunsStatusController.php)\" as RunsCtrl
participant \"OperationReportCsvDownloadController\n(app/Http/Controllers/OperationReportCsvDownloadController.php)\" as DownloadCtrl

participant \"Queue (jobs)\" as Q
participant \"ProcessOperationCsvImportJob\n(ProcessOperationCsvImportJob)\" as PIJ
participant \"ProcessOperationCsvImportChunkJob\n(ProcessOperationCsvImportChunkJob)\" as PICJ
participant \"FinalizeOperationCsvImportRunJob\n(FinalizeOperationCsvImportRunJob)\" as FIJ

participant \"ProcessOperationCsvExportJob\n(ProcessOperationCsvExportJob)\" as PEJ
participant \"ProcessOperationCsvExportChunkJob\n(ProcessOperationCsvExportChunkJob)\" as PECJ
participant \"FinalizeOperationCsvExportRunJob\n(FinalizeOperationCsvExportRunJob)\" as FEJ

participant \"Importer\nOperationCsvImporter\n(app/Infrastructure/Import/OperationCsvImporter.php)\" as Importer
participant \"ReportGenerator\nOperationCsvReportGenerator\n(app/Infrastructure/Report/OperationCsvReportGenerator.php)\" as Generator

database \"Banco (models & tables)\nOperationImportRun, OperationImportRunChunk,\nOperationImportRunError, OperationImportStagingRow,\nOperationReportRun, OperationReportRunChunk,\nOperation, Client, Agreement, Installments\" as DB

collections \"Notifications (database)\" as Notifications

== Fluxo inicial / tela ==
User -> UI : GET /operations
UI -> ListCtrl : request
ListCtrl -> DB : OperationListQuery + latest runs (OperationImportRun/OperationReportRun)
ListCtrl --> UI : rendered view (operations.index)

== Import (web) ==
User -> UI : POST /operations/import/csv (csv file)
UI -> ImportCtrl : upload
ImportCtrl -> Importer : ensureHeaderIsValid(file) note right: OperationCsvImporter::ensureHeaderIsValid
ImportCtrl -> DB : create OperationImportRun (status=pending)
ImportCtrl -> Q : dispatch ProcessOperationCsvImportJob(run_id)
ImportCtrl --> UI : response 202 / redirect com mensagem

Q -> PIJ : run job (operationImportRunId)
PIJ -> DB : claim run (pending -> processing) and save started_at
PIJ -> Importer : buildChunkPlan(file)
PIJ -> DB : insert OperationImportRunChunk rows
PIJ -> Q : dispatch ProcessOperationCsvImportChunkJob for each chunk
PIJ -> Q : dispatch FinalizeOperationCsvImportRunJob(run_id)

note over PICJ,Importer: Cada chunk -> PICJ -> Importer::importWithSummary(...)
PICJ -> Importer : importWithSummary(filePath, startLine, endLine, ...)
Importer -> Importer : validate rows, enqueue staging/errors
Importer -> \"OperationImportRowPersister\n(app/Infrastructure/Import/Persistence/OperationImportRowPersister.php)\" : persistMany(validatedRows)
\"OperationImportRowPersister\" -> DB : upsert clients/agreements, insert operations/installments (via OperationImportPersistenceEloquentMysqlQuery)
PICJ -> DB : update chunk status/metrics/errors
PICJ -> Q : dispatch FinalizeOperationCsvImportRunJob(run_id) note right: sempre agenda finalize ao terminar

FIJ -> DB : lock run, aggregate chunks, set run final status (completed / completed_with_errors / failed)
FIJ -> Notifications : persist OperationImportFinishedNotification (database)
Notifications -> User : user sees notification in UI

== Export (web) ==
User -> UI : GET /operations/report/csv?filters
UI -> ExportCtrl : request
ExportCtrl -> DB : create OperationReportRun (status=pending)
ExportCtrl -> Q : dispatch ProcessOperationCsvExportJob(run_id)
ExportCtrl --> UI : response 202 / redirect

Q -> PEJ : run export job
PEJ -> DB : claim run (pending -> processing)
PEJ -> Generator : buildChunkPlan(filters, workerCount)
PEJ -> DB : insert OperationReportRunChunk rows
PEJ -> Q : dispatch ProcessOperationCsvExportChunkJob for each chunk
PEJ -> Q : dispatch FinalizeOperationCsvExportRunJob(run_id)

PECJ -> Generator : generateChunk(filters, reference_date, runId, chunkIndex, startId, endId)
Generator -> DB : OperationReportCsvQuery -> cursorByIdRange(...) (fetch operations + installments)
Generator -> \"Domain services (PresentValueCalculator, OperationRateResolver)\" : calculate present value
Generator -> Storage : write partial CSV file (chunk)
PECJ -> DB : update chunk (output_file_path, total_rows, metrics, status)
PECJ -> Q : dispatch FinalizeOperationCsvExportRunJob(run_id)

FEJ -> DB : lock run, ensure all chunks finished, merge chunk files (OperationCsvReportGenerator::mergeChunkFiles)
FEJ -> DB : set run status=completed, output_file_path, metrics
FEJ -> Notifications : persist OperationReportFinishedNotification (database)
Notifications -> User : user sees notification

== Download ==
User -> DownloadCtrl : GET /operations/report/csv/download/{operationReportRun}
DownloadCtrl -> DB : verify requested_by_user_id and status completed
DownloadCtrl -> Storage : return file (response->download)
DownloadCtrl --> User : CSV file
@enduml

lock run, aggregate chunks, set run final status (completed / completed_with_errors / failed)
